fields.Name: Teams Channel Webhook
fields.Description: Webhook URL for posting to a Microsoft Teams channel, from an Office 365 connector or a Power Automate Workflows 'post to a channel when a webhook request is received' flow. Used by the Post Task Assignment to Teams action; name the credential after the task type's Code.

_comments: Matched by its name: a host that already holds this type (bizapps-common ships it too) keeps its row; a host without it gets one.
